principles: A product candidate may be rejected only by an authoritative check declared for that operation and only when the check completes its intended evaluation.

A verifier crash, navigation loss, missing artifact caused by an earlier verifier crash, runner failure, checkout failure, or unavailable external service is QUALIFIER_INFRA_FAILURE, not PRODUCT_FAIL.
A check from another page, project, benchmark lane, clone lane, or deployment provider is non-blocking unless the active operation explicitly declares it as a dependency.
External deployment providers do not block GitHub Pages operations unless the operation manifest names that provider as publication authority.
False-positive scope inside a gate must be repaired in the gate; product bytes must not be mutated to satisfy evidence the gate was never authorized to evaluate.

requires: one or more declared acceptance criteria explicitly failed

examples: missing result artifact because verifier crashed
asset gate treats changed asset as its own loader
unrelated project result used against current operation
Vercel quota/deployment failure when GitHub Pages is publication authority
Benchmark Compass failure during root Compass operation unless declared
